description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Source mapping: Page Task 4 Build plans and materialize once.

**Files:** `lib/zaq/channels/delivery_files.ex`, proposed `delivery_plan.ex` and `file_requirements.ex`.

**Work:** add one plan-building entry point for every communication Outgoing, normalize Agent attachment_error and configuration/materialization failures into shared policy handling, return ordinary error-free empty-attachment outgoing messages unchanged before any requirements lookup or preparation, query requirements when files need preparation, validate actual bytes, and produce ordered message groups plus explicit upload-request batches using bridge-provided exact sizing. Preserve the relation between every upload batch and its intended message group. Keep delivery_plan nil on passthrough; only planned outcomes enter the executor. Stop prevents execution on a preparation failure; continue retains usable files or creates the text-only outcome with safe failure reporting. Add placement and root-candidate descriptions. Preserve original indices and all failure evidence.

**Tests:** extend `test/zaq/channels/delivery_files_test.exs` and `attachment_policy_test.exs`. Existing tests already prove real Storage authorization, forged/expired/revoked handles, raw/base64 normalization, source preservation, and once-only materialization; retain them.

**Add scenarios:** six attachments with one materialization failure deliver the remaining five under continue and report the failed original index; stop sends none. An Agent attachment_error with no selected files enters DeliveryFiles, produces the existing safe text notice under continue, and blocks delivery under stop. Also assert ordinary text-only outgoing equality and a nil plan, with zero requirements, materialization, grouping, or executor calls even when attachment settings are absent. Cover fifteen files producing ten plus five, byte limits splitting earlier, individual oversize, all preparations failing, missing required limits causing no acquisition, and complete original-index accounting. Add one message group requiring two upload requests, exact encoded request limit and one-byte-over, a single file that cannot fit a request, and proof that the planned request count matches actual transport calls.

**Properties:** every eligible original index belongs to exactly one group; each group meets resolved constraints; order is stable; failures and successes partition the inputs; raw bytes remain unchanged.

**Reuse:** extend DeliveryFiles and reuse Materialization plus validated DecodeBase64 Action calls. Grouping and dependency construction are local domain transformations with no independent permission or side-effect contract, so no new Action is justified.

**Mocking and docs:** real Records, handles, Storage, and dispatch; stub only provider edges. Update module docs and channels delivery contract.

Reuse/verification: use the existing owner and tests named above; no parallel transport pipeline, new history store, automatic Action/tool exposure or Agent-selection changes. Scope any new scheduler unit suite to genuinely distinct invariants.
title: [zaq-1lw.4] Build delivery plans and materialize attachments once
